text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, azithromycin is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale General and Corvale East both stock azithromycin 500 mg tablets labeled by Proficient Rx LP (NDC 71205067403). Corvale East has 120 tablets (7.6 days on hand); Corvale General has 368 tablets (23.4 days on hand). Pfizer Inc. posted a discontinuation for azithromycin tablets dated 2026-04-09, but that NDC differs from the product in use at Corvale.

Why (FDA record): FDA's most recent inspection of the Proficient Rx LP plant (FEI 3011557028) ended 2022-12-08 and was classified VAI. An earlier inspection ended 2015-10-22 and was also classified VAI. FDA's drug shortage list does not include azithromycin as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current supply at Corvale General supports a one-time transfer to Corvale East without jeopardizing General's inventory. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list, but their labels do not identify a plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 101 tablets of azithromycin 500 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, or AvKARE if supply gaps persist — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No other actions at this time.
